hire_title: SAP S/4HANA Implementation Specialist for Mergers & Acquisitions
hire_description:
We are seeking a SAP S/4HANA implementation specialist to help large shipping companies navigate complex post-merger digital transformations. The ideal candidate will have experience with SAP S/4HANA and has successfully implemented ERP systems in multi-country environments, particularly in the context of mergers and acquisitions.

Key responsibilities include:
* Conducting a thorough assessment of the client's current finance system to identify areas for improvement
* Developing a comprehensive implementation plan that takes into account cultural differences and regulatory requirements across multiple countries
* Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders and IT teams to ensure smooth project execution and user adoption
* Implementing SAP S/4HANA ReFX and IFRS16 lease accounting compliance within an aggressive timeline of 5-8 months

hire_title: Develop AI solution for engineering requirements rewriting and metadata tagging
hire_description:
Develop an AI-based workflow to automate the rewriting and metadata tagging of 750 engineering documents. Requirements include: 
- Rewrite requirement statements using INCOSE and EARS standards.
- Assign metadata tags from a hierarchical taxonomy of over 1,000 options.
- Create cross-references and identify similar requirements.
- Implement via a web application using Generative AI and vector databases.
hire_description_additional_notes: Discipline engineers can dedicate only 20% of their time to validation. Solution must adhere to responsible AI governance principles.

hire_title: Implement managed finance function with ERP integration and multi-jurisdictional compliance
hire_description:
We are an impact investment firm with $1.7B in AUM that recently transitioned to an independent operating structure. We need to establish a fully functioning finance organization in under six months while keeping internal resources focused on investment growth. The solution must be cost-effective, scalable, and compliant across multiple jurisdictions.

Scope of work includes:
- Conduct a gap-fit analysis to recommend rapid data migration and onboarding solutions without lengthy system implementation.
- Deploy a pre-configured enterprise resource planning (ERP) system with standardized processes for transaction processing and management reporting.
- Provide specialized support for statutory and tax requirements across local jurisdictions via country specialists.
- Ensure audit readiness and reliable controls from day one to meet strict impact reporting standards.
hire_description_additional_notes: Timeline: Under six months for full function establishment. Seniority: Partner-led engagement with cross-domain professionals and country specialists. Budget: Must be cost-effective to avoid heavy internal build-out costs.

hire_title: AI Transformation Consultant: Responsible AI for Business
hire_description: Transform a business through responsible AI adoption, leveraging EY's expertise in AI transformation. Develop strategic pathways to navigate the complexities of AI change with confidence and precision. Identify key areas for improvement and implement solutions that promote humans-at-the-center transformation approach.

hire_title: Tax and Finance Managed Services Transition and Transformation Consultant
hire_description: We require a specialist to transition our in-house tax and finance functions to a managed services model. The scope includes: - Assessing current operations to identify transferable core elements. - Migrating financial data to a secure, technology-enabled environment, including cleaning and restructuring for multi-purpose use. - Designing a transformation plan that enhances operational resilience, risk profile, and governance while reducing cost pressure.

hire_title: Managed Finance and Operations Transformation Specialist
hire_description: Transform complex life reinsurance companies' finance and operations infrastructure through outsourcing key functions to a trusted partner. Establish robust governance frameworks, scalable systems, and provide end-to-end support for rapid growth and compliance.
hire_description_additional_notes:
The ideal candidate will have knowledge of advanced cloud-based technologies (e.g. SAP S/4HANA) and experience in delivering integrated finance managed services across accounting, FP&A, tax, investment accounting, and actuarial and valuations support.

    The engagement will involve collaborating with a small team to stand up a fully operational platform in record time (6-9 months), with potential for future scale-ups.

hire_title: People-Centered Change Management Consultant for Large Organizations
hire_description:
We're seeking a consultant to help our clients transform their organizations through a people-centered approach. The ideal candidate will have experience in delivering successful change management programs, leveraging data and analytics to inform strategic decisions, and designing innovative activation experiences to drive adoption.

Key requirements include:

* Developing and implementing customized change management strategies that prioritize employee engagement and adoption
* Utilizing data and analytics tools to measure the effectiveness of change initiatives and identify areas for improvement
* Collaborating with senior business leaders to design and deliver impactful communication and activation plans

The ideal candidate will have experience working with large, global organizations and a track record of delivering successful transformation programs. Proven expertise in people-centered change management, data-driven decision making, and innovative engagement strategies is essential.

hire_title: Legal consultant for cross-border antitrust clearances and JV structuring
hire_description: We need legal counsel to structure a non-profit joint venture for a global blockchain trade data utility in the shipping industry. The scope includes advising on the optimal entity structure to minimize regulatory hurdles and securing antitrust clearances in multiple jurisdictions, including Chile, Poland, South Korea, and Ukraine. You will coordinate with local counsel to prepare antitrust filings, collate data for regulators, and manage the approval process to enable the platform's launch.

hire_title: AI solution to automate insurance claims processing from unstructured and semi-structured documents
hire_description: A Nordic insurer sought to automate its claims management process, which relied on agents manually reading scanned images, PDFs, bills, invoices, pharmacy receipts, clinic documents, and medical diagnoses, then extracting and categorizing the relevant data. We needed an AI-powered solution to convert semi-structured and unstructured documents into actionable structured data, feed it to our core claims system, and free agents to focus on customer relationships.

hire_title: ICT project management office for a private sector-led sports and urban revitalization megaproject
hire_description: We are building Nagasaki Stadium City, a private sector-led urbanization project centered on a ~20,000-seat soccer stadium and ~6,000-seat arena, plus a hotel, commercial facilities, and offices. We need a project management office to take overall responsibility for ICT across the entire regional development project. Scope includes: designing digital services from scratch around an agreed initial vision and customer experience goals; delivering a holistic ICT design spanning touchpoints, a high-speed network, and supporting infrastructure; optimizing operations to reduce labor, including visualizing shift management for events and normal times; leveraging big data from a unified visitor app for preference-based analysis and continuous improvement; and acting as a neutral party in vendor negotiations for large-scale orders. The ICT must be designed for long-term updates and operational efficiency to keep the facility sustainable.

Our life insurer client sought to explore direct distribution of simplified products and understand how a digital offering could benefit their core business. They aimed to build a retirement-income community and provide a robo-guidance tool for a multi-touch, interactive experience. Against the backdrop of industry-wide fee compression, we helped them leverage technological changes in financial services and the growing popularity of digital advice platforms.

hire_title: Turnaround Consultant for Complex Corporate Restructuring and Asset Divestment
hire_description: We require an experienced Turnaround and Restructuring Specialist to lead the financial and operational restructuring of a large, insolvent conglomerate operating across aviation, hotel, and financial sectors. The engagement involves navigating a court-supervised bankruptcy process to restructure debt, simplify complex shareholding structures, and streamline the portfolio for sustainable growth. Key deliverables include: Assessing the going concern status and advising on the restructuring of assets, liabilities, and shareholdings. Executing the sale of non-core assets to repay M&A loans and reduce expenses. Implementing business and management restructuring to improve operational efficiency and profitability. Acting as a communication bridge between creditors, strategic investors, and internal stakeholders to secure buy-in for the restructuring plan.
hire_description_additional_notes: The restructuring must be completed within a strict nine-month regulatory deadline. Seniority expectations include Partner-level leadership with experience in large-scale Chinese corporate restructurings and international debt resolution.

hire_title: Strategic Consultancy for Geospatial Data Monetization and AI Integration
hire_description:

- Defining open, platform-agnostic data formats to ensure cross-industry compatibility with various architectures.
- Developing risk governance frameworks and implementing zero-trust security measures, including least-privilege access and continuous verification, to establish data trustworthiness.

hire_title: Enterprise Strategy and Digital Transformation Consultant for Insurance Spin-off
hire_description: We require a strategic advisor to design and lead the digital transformation of a new life insurance entity being spun off from our legacy business. Key deliverables include: defining guiding principles for a lean, agile operating model; conducting business architecture analysis across front-to-back office functions to determine people, process, and technology needs; chartering initiatives to separate essential systems and business operations from the parent company; and developing a future-state roadmap with specific milestones for cloud migration and SaaS adoption.

hire_title: Data Governance Specialist for Insurance Sector
hire_description: We are a large general and life insurer in Asia with cross-border and global operations, seeking a trusted data governance specialist who understands the insurance sector. The ideal candidate will help us develop, implement, and align our data governance standards and processes at a group level. Key challenges include minimal data standardisation across architecture, existing gaps in data cleansing, and the need for central ownership of Personal Identifiable Information (P-II).

hire_title: Design and Implement AI-Powered Digital Transformation for State Agency
hire_description: A large state transportation agency needs to modernize its services and deliver seamless digital experiences to residents. We need to engage EY to harness AI-powered opportunities for streamlining processes, automating manual tasks, and enhancing organizational effectiveness. The digital transformation should be driven by the customer experience using intelligent automation to build virtual services such as vehicle renewals, registrations, and payment processing to keep pace with consumer expectations.

hire_title: Advisor to design, implement, and launch Adobe Marketo Engage marketing automation platform

- Conduct validation sessions with stakeholder groups (marketing operations, sales, enterprise architecture, data analytics) to define high-value use cases and required capabilities
